#### Description
<!--- Describe your changes in detail -->
Added Relative Volume Indicator. The indicator measures current cumulative volume from open to the time of day to x days prior volume.

Calculation: cumulative volume from open to the time of day / cumulative average volume from open to time of day for x prior days

Eager to get started using on this indicator. Any thoughts on when this will be reviewed & merged? Possibly this weekend?
cc: @Martin-Molinero
Gentle nudge on this. It's the missing piece to a strategy I am developing.
Looking forward to hopefully seeing this PR reviewed/accepted. A RVOL indicator seems like an excellent addition that could be used by tons of strategies.

I'm sure that's not your intended review cadence, but it might be worth being even more exhaustive in this review round.  Can you spot any other potential issues?

> To save time going back and forth, would it be helpful to take longer to do an even deeper dive, one-time?

No, I think current approach looks good! We've discussed it offline too.
Current review is about improving this approach and not refactoring it as previous were 👍
Thanks @Martin-Molinero and @ikamanu for sticking with me on this. Will make changes and push during my lunch.

Ah, understood. @Martin-Molinero. Thanks again for the help.  
PS: We have at least one more indicator PR landing in the coming weeks --we'll apply all this feedback as well!
